Seagrove

.4 mile to San Juan Public Beach Access

Private pool! With optional heat!

3 bedrooms, a loft, 3 full baths, 2 half-baths

5 bikes!

Gas grill

4-star restaurants

Lofty Oasis by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Lofty Oasis is all about unwinding in style. Fill your days and evenings with poolside lounging, and quiet moments on the two large porches. You’ll love the morning light, afternoon breezes, and evening chats with a neighborhood view. And yes, there’s a private pool! Inside, the main living area is bright, open, and ready for good times.

The dining table’s got room for big meals and board games, while the fully stocked kitchen is set for pancake flipping or late-night snacking. The primary suite, king, features a private bath, plus there's a half bath and a laundry room that leads right to the backyard. And the pool! Cool off, soak up the sun, or lounge in the covered hangout space, with a half bath, outdoor shower, and cornhole for some friendly competition. Upstairs, another primary suite, king, brings the luxury, with a private bath, while a guest room, queen, also features an extra twin bed and a loft with bunk beds and a twin, to keep things comfy. Plenty of room for the whole crew! Lofty Oasis is made for memory-making, laugh-til-you-cry moments, and a whole lot of fun. Pack your bags, rally your crew, and get ready for a good time! At Oversee 30A, we keep it simple: clean, comfy stays with a local team always close by. Our office is nearby, open seven days a week, with 24/7 support if you need anything. Overview: - .4 mile to the beach (San Juan Public Beach Access) - 3 bedroom (plus loft), 3 full baths, and 2 half baths - Propane grill - Wi-Fi - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - 5 bikes included Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, single twin bed, shared hall bath, TV - Bunkroom Loft: Twin over twin bunk beds, shared hall bath, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
